content.hebrew: אֵל עֶלְיוֹן, דּוֹבֵר צֶֽדֶק מַגִּיד מֵישָׁרִים,
content.transliteration: El ‘elyon, dover tsedeḳ maggid mesharim,
content.english: El ‘Elyon, who speaks justice, and says righteous words,
content.comments: El ‘Elyon. A name for God; traditional English “the most high God.”

content.hebrew: הוֹרָה לְנֶאֱמַן בֵּיתוֹ לְצַוּוֹת זֶֽרַע יְשָׁרִים,
content.transliteration: Hora lene’eman beto letsavvot zera‘ yesharim,
content.english: Instructed the faithful one of His house to command the progeny of the upright
content.comments: The faithful one of His house. Moses.

content.hebrew: רַצֵּי כֶֽסֶף יִתְּנוּ לְהָכִין שֶֽׁמֶן זֵיתִים זַכִּים וּבָרִים,
content.transliteration: Rats’tsē khesef yittenu lehakhin shemen zetim zakkim uvarim,
content.english: That they should give offerings of silver to prepare pure, clean olive oil,

content.hebrew: נֵר לְהַעֲלוֹת מֵעֶֽרֶב עַד בְּקָרִים.
content.transliteration: Ner leha‘a lot me‘erev ‘ad beḳarim.
content.english: To have a lamp lit from evening until morning;

content.hebrew: וּבָחוֹר לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו לְכַהֵן, וְלִהְיוֹתָם בְּרוּרִים,
content.transliteration: Uvaḥor le’Aharon ulvanav lekhahen, velihyotam berurim,
content.english: And to choose Aaron and his sons to serve as priests, and for them to be distinct,

content.hebrew: וְלַעֲשׂוֹת לָהֶם בִּגְדֵי קֹֽדֶשׁ, לְכָבוֹד וַהֲדָרִים:
content.transliteration: Vela‘asot lahem biḡdē ḳodesh, lekhavod vahadarim:
content.english: And to make them holy vestments, for glory and beauty:

content.hebrew: כְּתֹֽנֶת תַּשְׁבֵּץ, וּמְעִיל – רִמּוֹן וּפַעֲמוֹן בּוֹ סְדוּרִים,
content.transliteration: Ketonet tashbets, um‘il – rimmon ufa‘amon bo sedurim,
content.english: An inlaid tunic, and a coat with pomegranates and bells arranged on it;

content.hebrew: וּמִצְנֶֽפֶת וְצִיץ זָהָב – כְּמִין כְּתָרִים,
content.transliteration: Umitsnefet vetsits zahav – kemin ketarim,
content.english: A turban, and a golden ẓiẓ—like a crown;

content.hebrew: וְאַבְנֵט – כְּמִין חֲגוֹר וֶאֱזוֹרִים,
content.transliteration: Ve’avnet – kemin ḥaḡor ve’ezorim,
content.english: And an avneṭ—like a belt, a girdle;

content.hebrew: וְאֵפוֹד – בִּשְׁתֵּי כְתֵפָיו אֲבָנִים יְקָרִים,
content.transliteration: Ve’efod – bishtē khetefav avanim yeḳarim,
content.english: And an ephod, with precious stones on its two shoulders,

content.hebrew: חֲקוּקִים בָּם שְׁמוֹת תְּרֵי עָשָׂר, לִהְיוֹתָם נִזְכָּרִים
content.transliteration: Ḥaḳuḳim bam shemot terē ‘asar, lihyotam nizkarim
content.english: In which the names of the twelve [tribes] are inscribed, so that they will be remembered

content.hebrew: לִפְנֵי אֵל, יוֹצֵר הָרִים;
content.transliteration: Lifnē El, yotser harim;
content.english: By God, sculptor of mountains;

content.hebrew: וְחֹֽשֶׁן מִשְׁפָּט בְּאַרְבָּעָה טוּרִים,
content.transliteration: Veḥoshen mishpat be’arba‘a turim,
content.english: And a breastplate of justice, with four rows,

content.hebrew: וְלָתֵת בּוֹ אֶת־הַתֻּמִּים וְאֶת־הָאוּרִים,
content.transliteration: Velatet bo et hattummim ve’et ha’urim,
content.english: And to place the Tummim and Urim in it,

content.hebrew: יָעִיר לֵב הַכֹּהֵן לְהַבְדִּיל אֱמֶת מִשְּׁקָרִים,
content.transliteration: Ya‘ir lev hakkohen lehavdil emet mish’sheḳarim,
content.english: To awaken the priest’s heart to distinguish truth from lies,

content.hebrew: וּלְהוֹפִֽיעַ לַשֹּׁאֵל דְּבָרִים נִסְתָּרִים –
content.transliteration: Ulhofi’a‘ lash’sho’el devarim nistarim –
content.english: And to make hidden matters appear to the questioner—

content.hebrew: וְכָל־אֵֽלּוּ בְּעִנְיָנִים פְּלָאִים, לֹא יְדָעוּם הַיְהִירִים;
content.transliteration: Vekhol ellu be‘inyanim pela’im lo yeda‘um hayhirim;
content.english: All these regard wondrous things, which the haughty do not know;

content.hebrew: וּמִכְנְסֵי בַד לְכַסּוֹת בְּשַׂר מַעְרִים,
content.transliteration: Umikhnesē vad lekhassot besar ma‘rim,
content.english: And linen trousers, to cover their procreative flesh,

content.hebrew: וְהָיוּ לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו הַכְּשֵׁרִים,
content.transliteration: Vehayu le’Aharon ulvanav hakkesherim,
content.english: Which will be for Aaron and his sons, the upright ones,

content.hebrew: בְּבֹאָם לְשָׁרֵת, וְלִהְיוֹתָם מַקְטִירִים.
content.transliteration: Bevo’am lesharet, velihyotam maḳtirim.
content.english: When they come to serve, and to offer incense.

content.hebrew: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים לְמַלֵּא בָם יָדָם יִהְיוּ סְפוּרִים,
content.transliteration: Shiv‘at yamim lemallē vam yadam yihyu sefurim,
content.english: Seven days shall be counted, to inaugurate them through [these vestments],

content.hebrew: וּפַר חַטָּאת לַיּוֹם, עַל הַכִּפּוּרִים,
content.transliteration: Ufar ḥattat layyom, ‘al hakkippurim,
content.english: And there should be an ox for the sin offering each day, to atone,

content.hebrew: וּלְחַטֵּא אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ – וְאָז יַעֲלוּ עָלָיו פָּרִים.
content.transliteration: Ulḥattē et hammizbe’aḥ – ve’az ya‘alu ‘alav parim.
content.english: And he-goats to atone for the altar—and then, oxen may be offered on it.

content.hebrew: וּלְמִזְבַּח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת – לְבַל יַעֲלוּ עָלָיו עוֹלָה וָנֶֽסֶךְ יִהְיוּ נִזְהָרִים.
content.transliteration: Ulmizbaḥ haḳḳetoret – leval ya‘alu ‘alav ‘ola vanesekh yihyu nizharim.
content.english: And the incense altar—they should be warned not to offer burnt offerings or libations on it.

content.hebrew: נִזְכֶּה עוֹד חֲזוֹת מִקְדָּשׁוֹ מְיֻסָּד בַּסַּפִּירִים,
content.transliteration: Nizkē ‘od ḥazot miḳdasho meyussad bassappirim,
content.english: May we again merit seeing His Temple, constructed with lapis lazuli,

content.hebrew: וְהַכֹּהֲנִים בְּשֵׁרוּתָם, וְהַלְוִיִּם שָׁרִים וְשֹׁעֲרִים,
content.transliteration: Vehakkohanim besherutam, vehalviyyim sharim vesho‘arim,
content.english: And the priests in their service, and the Levites singing and operating the gates!

content.hebrew: וְהָיָה יוי לְמֶֽלֶךְ, וּמִגַּעֲרָתוֹ יִמַּֽסּוּ הָרִים!
content.transliteration: Vehaya Adonai lemelekh, umigga‘arato yimmassu harim!
content.english: And Adonai will be king, and the mountains will melt from His rebuke!

content.hebrew: קהל: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יוי אֶחָד מְאֻשָּׁר בְּסִפּוּרִים.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Bayyom hahu yihyē Adonai eḥad me’ush’shar besippurim.
content.english: Cong. On that day, Adonai will be one, acclaimed with tales.

content.hebrew: חזן: וְהָיָ֧ה יו֛י לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶ֧ה יו֛י אֶחָ֖ד וּשְׁמ֥וֹ אֶחָֽד: (זכריה יד:ט)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Vehaya Adonai lemelekh ‘al kol ha’arets bayyom hahu yihyē Adonai eḥad ushmo eḥad:
content.english: Cantor. And Adonai will be king over the entire world; on that day, Adonai will be one, and His name one. (Zech. 14:9)

content.hebrew: קהל: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יו֥י אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יו֥י ׀ אֶחָֽד: (דברים ו:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Shema‘ Yisra’el Adonai elohenu Adonai, eḥad:
content.english: Cong. Hear O Israel, Adonai our God is Adonai on His own. (Deut. 6:4)
content.comments: Adonai on His own. The translation follows Sefer Ha-mivḥar on Deuteronomy 6:4: “The meaning is that He is one, and does not need any second one.”
